why: The `try` used to CONTINUE rather than to classify -- the failure mode wrapping a constructor invites. The scene reports success and returns a context whose renderer is undefined, so the browser that cannot render gets no branded state at all and instead a null dereference in the first frame, far from the boundary that knew what went wrong.
killedBy: createScene when the browser will not give it a context (issue #325) throws the TYPED failure, not a bare Error
createScene when the browser will not give it a context (issue #325) surfaces as the CONTEXT failure, not as a null dereference further down
